subject: Hosted API architecture deep-dive — coordination and attendee list
messages:
From: Tim Jensen <tim.jensen@clearwavehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Ari Patel <ari@clearwavehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Hosted API deep-dive — request to schedule

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. The engineering team at Clearwave wants to do a deeper architecture session focused on the Hosted API integration surface: SDKs, streaming options, and tool/function calling. We also need to validate network egress, auth flows, and a rough rollout plan for pilot traffic.

Can we schedule a 60–75 minute technical session next week? Our core asks:
- Walk through the Hosted API SDKs and recommended integration patterns (Node/Python).
- Live demo of streaming responses and best practices for partial renders.
- Discuss function/tool calling and how we can enforce structured outputs for our EHR enrichment pipelines.
- Network/auth checklist for procurement/security.

Attendees from our side: me, Ari (engineering), and our procurement contact (procurement@clearwavehealth.com) — they may only join for the last 15 minutes. Please include any pre-reads you want us to review.

Thanks,
Tim

—
Tim Jensen
Senior Engineering Manager
Clearwave Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
To: Tim Jensen <tim.jensen@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Ari Patel <ari@clearwavehealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.example.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API deep-dive — request to schedule

Hi Tim — great to hear the engineering team wants a deep-dive. Happy to run this. Proposed plan and times below.

High-level agenda (estimate 60–75 mins):
1) 5 min intros + objectives
2) 15 min SDK overview (Node/Python snippets, auth patterns) — Marissa
3) 20 min live streaming demo + partial response handling — Rishi
4) 15 min function/tool calling and deterministic output patterns — Dev
5) 10–20 min network/auth + procurement checklist and Q&A — Marissa + Rishi

Proposed times (all ET):
- Tue Jul 20, 10:00–11:15am ET
- Wed Jul 21, 2:00–3:15pm ET
- Thu Jul 22, 9:30–10:45am ET

Pre-reads attached: redwood-hosted-api-arch-agenda.pdf and a network diagram we can reference. Rishi, Dev — adding you for any prep items.

If you prefer a calendar invite, we can send one once you confirm a slot.

Best,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Tim Jensen <tim.jensen@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.example.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 13:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API deep-dive — request to schedule

Adding a couple quick notes from the engineering side so Tim's team can triage before the call:

Pre-read suggestions (small set):
- short SDK sample (Node streaming + reconnect pattern) — we can drop a gist
- expected TLS/cipher minimums and IP ranges (we'll surface a one-pager)
- example function schema we use for downstream structured outputs (JSON schema)

Action items for the session:
- I'll demo a streaming session where the client consumes partial tokens and a fallback to batch mode on reconnect.
- Dev, can you prepare a short slide that shows how function calling maps to events in a typical EHR enrichment pipeline?

We should also confirm whether Clearwave needs a short NDA-addendum for deeper network details; if procurement requests that, loop legal (cc procurement).

-Rishi
Principal Solutions Engineer
From: Tim Jensen <tim.jensen@clearwavehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Ari Patel <ari@clearwavehealth.com>, procurement@clearwavehealth.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API deep-dive — request to schedule

Marissa — apologies, schedule changed on our side. Can we move the session to Wed Jul 21 but start at 3:00pm ET instead of 2:00pm? The later slot would let Ari finish a morning standup offsite. Procurement will plan to join the final 20 minutes.

Also: procurement asked for any compliance artifacts you can share prior to the call (SOC 2 scope, data retention overview). If you can post links or a short doc to your shared drive, that'll help speed procurement review.

Thanks,
Tim
